svg.title: Datum site analysis: WaKeeney, Kansas
svg.desc: Generated 2026-09-25T08:58:42.231Z. Sources listed in the attribution group. Coordinates 39.01977, -99.88373.

g.text: heights known for 0 of 20 buildings; levels known for 0. contours at 1 m. FEMA flood polygons unavailable

text.tspan: Walking speed 80 m per minute. Start node 20 m from the site point. Unreached streets in the fetch extent are faint.

ASCE 7-22, RISK CATEGORY II, SITE CLASS D
Site class is the default, not measured

text.tspan: Site Class D and Risk Category II are defaults. A site specific geotechnical report is required to
confirm site class.
FEMA flood data could not be reached (upstream_error). Verify at msc.fema.gov.
Overhang projection over glazing height is 1 / tan(summer solstice noon altitude): geometry only, no site
obstructions.

g.text: Band: mean daily minimum to maximum. Tick: monthly mean. Dashed: relative humidity, 0 to 100 percent over the band height.
Hours between 18 and 26 C with relative humidity under 70 percent. Simple comfort band, not ASHRAE 55.

text.tspan: The site sits at 743.9518 m elevation [topo.siteElevationM]. Relief across the site
is 9.9 m [topo.reliefM], with the north-south section running from 739.371704102 m to
748.531311035 m [topo.sections.ns[]] and the east-west section from 742.511291504 m
to 746.467895508 m [topo.sections.ew[]]. Mean slope is 1.4 percent
[topo.meanSlopePct] and aspect is 143.1 degrees [topo.aspectDeg], meaning the slope
faces southeast. That orientation is useful for south-facing glazing but check the
lower northern edge for drainage accumulation. The dominant soil component is Harney
silt loam at 97 percent of the map unit [soil.components[].percent], well drained,
hydrologic group C [soil.components[].hydrologicGroup]. Minor components Ness and
Aquolls are poorly drained and hydric [soil.components[].hydric], so locate
impervious area and any below-grade construction toward the well-drained majority.
Plan for moderate stormwater runoff given group C soils.
Heating demand significantly exceeds cooling: 2658.7 heating degree days versus 764.6
cooling degree days, base 18.3 C [climate.degreeDays.hdd] [climate.degreeDays.cdd].
Only 17.3 percent of hours fall in the simple comfort band
[climate.comfortShare.pct]. January mean daily minimum is -7.05 C and July mean daily
maximum is 31.47 C [climate.monthly[].meanDailyMinC]
[climate.monthly[].meanDailyMaxC]. The envelope should prioritize thermal mass and
insulation for heating, with controlled south glazing. The overhang ratio for south
glazing is 0.2789 [sun.overhangRatioSouthGlazing]. June solar noon altitude reaches
74.4177 degrees and December drops to 27.5424 degrees [sun.june.noonAltitudeDeg]
[sun.december.noonAltitudeDeg], a large seasonal swing that rewards a well-tuned
fixed overhang. Peak daily radiation is 7.082 kWh/m2 in July
[climate.monthly[].meanDailyRadiationKwhM2]. Summer wind prevails from 180 degrees at
a mean of 3.896 m/s [climate.wind.summer.prevailingSectorDeg]
[climate.wind.summer.meanSpeedMs]; orient operable openings to capture south breezes
in summer. Winter wind shifts to 315 degrees
[climate.wind.winter.prevailingSectorDeg], so buffer the northwest facade with mass
or a windbreak.
The area has very low density at 1.2 persons per km2 [census.derived.densityPerKm2].
There are 20 buildings mapped nearby, none with recorded height or level data
[osm.stats.buildingCount] [osm.stats.withHeight], so shadowing from neighbors cannot
be quantified. Coverage ratio of surrounding built fabric is 0.018
[osm.stats.coverageRatio], confirming an open landscape with minimal obstruction to
sun or wind. Walking reach in 5 minutes is 3.05 km [walkshed.reachKm.5]. Zero transit
stops fall within a 15-minute walk [walkshed.transitWithin.15] and zero workers
commute by transit [census.transitToWork], so the program must assume full automobile
dependence. Design for generous on-site parking and clear vehicular entry.
Seismic design category is A under ASCE 7-22, risk category II, site class D (default
assumption) [seismic.sdc] [seismic.assumptions.reference]
[seismic.assumptions.siteClass] [seismic.assumptions.siteClassIsDefault]. Mapped
short-period spectral acceleration Ss is 0.13 and SDS is 0.11 [seismic.ss]
[seismic.sds]. Seismic demand is minimal and will not govern structural design. Wind
exposure from an open flat landscape at this latitude should govern lateral design
instead. The site class D default has not been confirmed by a geotechnical
investigation; obtain borings before finalizing foundation type.
Flood zone data is unavailable because FEMA flood data could not be reached due to an
upstream error. Verify flood zone designation directly at msc.fema.gov before setting
finish floor elevation or designing any stormwater outfall. Building height data is
absent from the OpenStreetMap layer, so shadow studies from neighboring structures
cannot be performed at this stage.
